evidenceBasedConclusions.conclusion: The most defensible current assessment is based on “Every EU Member State must make at least one European Digital Identity Wallet available by the end of 2026,” the strongest indexed record by source grade and evidence status.
evidenceBasedConclusions.evidence: The European Commission says Member States will make wallets available to citizens, residents and businesses by the end of 2026. More than 550 companies and public authorities across 26 Member States and associated countries have participated in large-scale pilots.
evidenceBasedConclusions.limitations: One strong record cannot by itself prove a wider pattern, motive, conspiracy or command structure.
evidenceBasedConclusions.alternativeInterpretation: The record may have a narrower legal or factual meaning than the surrounding public narrative suggests.
